title: Validate the existing general ObjectFIFO

base_snapshot.pre_change_manifest_match: 870/870 files matched by size and SHA-256

kernel_change.defect: The MicroPython adapter default timeout -1 becomes 0xffffffffffffffff in unsigned ObjCall.arg0; bounded(...,0x7fffffff) rejected it with Ebadarg instead of an infinite wait.
kernel_change.fix: Treat 0xffffffffffffffff and 0xffffffff as -1 before vobjfiforecv(); keep finite waits bounded to 0x7fffffff ms.

followup_2026_11_07.scope: Narrow follow-up to completed T11. Strengthen four weak assertions, test subscription close versus a blocked receive, and change no kernel code unless a reachable defect is demonstrated.
followup_2026_11_07.pre_change_manifest_match: working tree matched the published snapshot for all inspected files before changes

revoke-wakes.original_weakness: READY was published before the worker necessarily blocked; any OSError was accepted.
revoke-wakes.strengthened: Default infinite receive after READY; parent requires the exact vobj: receive timed out in a 300 ms no-result window before revoke; child reports its exact error; parent requires i/o on hungup channel (Ehungup).
revoke-wakes.observed: T11-B blocked-settle PASS; T11-B revoke-err i/o on hungup channel; T11-B revoke-wakes PASS
revoke-wakes.limitation: Kernel sleeper state is not exposed by the API; the window is an observation procedure plus exact error checks, not a direct tsleep probe.

no-ambient-handle.original_weakness: The child guessed integer handles 1..63; generation-tagged handles made that weak.
no-ambient-handle.strengthened: Parent passes its real full-width secret Handle value as child data and delegates an AUTH-CTRL object with Vread+Vmeta. Child must read the control (positive control), get the exact bad arg in system call when using the passed Handle, and find no own Handle with the parent secret OID.
no-ambient-handle.observed: ambient-result 110; ambient-control PASS; ambient-denied PASS; ambient-oid-unreachable PASS; no-ambient-handle PASS

exit-reaped.strengthened: Assert reaped PID == terminated child and status == micropython <pid>: terminated.
exit-reaped.observed: T11-B exit-status micropython 12: terminated; exit-pid PASS; exit-status PASS; exit-reaped PASS

quota-global-limit.original_weakness: Any OSError was accepted and queue counters were not checked.
quota-global-limit.strengthened: 64 subscribers = 8 children x 7 + 8 parent witness subscriptions; 1024 sends queue 65536 messages; next send must fail with exact kernel allocate failed (Enomem); before/after FIFO sends/drops and all witness (capacity, queued, dropped) snapshots must be unchanged.
quota-global-limit.observed: quota-error kernel allocate failed; quota-global-limit PASS; quota-no-partial-send PASS; quota-no-partial-drop PASS; quota-witness-count PASS; quota-witness-full PASS (8 x 1024/1024/0); quota-queues-unchanged PASS

subscription_close_while_blocked.source_finding: vobjfiforecv holds a Vhand reference across tsleep; vobjclosehandle removes the slot and calls vhandput, but the receive's reference prevents the final drop, so vsudetach/vsubshutd is not called and a blocked receiver would not be woken by that close.
subscription_close_while_blocked.reachability: Unreachable through the supported contract: the Handle table is process-local; OSPAWN starts empty and vobjspawninherit rejects subscriptions ('object: subscriptions cannot cross OSPAWN'); RFORK/newproc starts with an empty native Handle table even when memory is shared. The blocked process cannot close its own Handle while blocked, and no other process/thread can.
subscription_close_while_blocked.distinctions: FIFO revocation wakes with Ehungup (tested); receiver termination interrupts the call and tears down the subscription (tested); stale Handle after close gives Ebadarg (tested); close-while-blocked is NOT RUN.
subscription_close_while_blocked.supported_contract: A subscription Handle is process-local and non-transferable; close it only when no receive is concurrently blocked on it. Revisit if future work shares the Handle table across threads.

discrimination.purpose: Show the strengthened assertions fail for intentionally wrong conditions while their positive controls pass.
discrimination.observed_fail: blocked-settle (early revoke), exit-status (normal exit), ambient-denied (authorized self-read), quota-global-limit and quota-no-partial-send (publish succeeds below quota), quota-wrong-error (pub on revoked FIFO gives vobj: FIFO is closed)
